name: Ghost Practice
description: Research mod: practice sessions that present themselves as normal-mode runs (in-memory only, nothing is written to the save file).

strip-practice-ui.name: Strip practice UI
strip-practice-ui.description: Hides checkpoint buttons, checkpoint diamonds and 'Practice Mode' texts while a disguised session is active.

disguise-end-screen.name: Normal end screen
disguise-end-screen.description: Level Complete screen is shown in its normal-mode variant instead of the practice variant.

freeze-labels.name: Freeze overlay labels
freeze-labels.description: Freezes matching label texts (FPS/CPS/Best Run/... incl. Mega Hack labels) at the moment the first checkpoint is placed.

freeze-label-patterns.name: Label text patterns
freeze-label-patterns.description: Comma-separated prefixes. Labels whose text starts with one of these are frozen. Case-insensitive. Formats confirmed in MH v9.1.3: 'FPS', 'CPS', 'Best Run: {}', 'Attempt {}'.

freeze-label-node-ids.name: Label node IDs
freeze-label-node-ids.description: Comma-separated Geode node IDs to freeze (matched exactly). Confirmed in MH v9.1.3: checkpoints-label, percentage-label.

spoof-attempt-label.name: Pin attempt label
spoof-attempt-label.description: Pins the on-screen attempt label to 'Attempt 1' during a disguised session.

final-restart-hotkey.name: Final restart hotkey (F9)
final-restart-hotkey.description: Press F9 during a disguised session: wipes all checkpoints, restarts from 0% and unfreezes labels.

debug-dump-tree.name: Debug: dump node trees
debug-dump-tree.description: Logs UILayer/PlayLayer/PauseLayer node trees to the Geode console. Use this to refine PracticeUICleaner filters.
